course.title: Federation & Peer Hubs
course.tagline: Announce, quarantine, preview, approve — how hubs join without trusting strangers.

m1.title: Well-known & announce
m1.concept: How a hub introduces itself and knocks on a peer — observation only, never an index.

m2.title: Open door vs closed door
m2.concept: Pending peers exist either way — preview is its own switch.

m3.title: Preview quarantine
m3.concept: Signed manifests land in a table no invoke/search reads.

m4.title: Declared vs read counts
m4.concept: What the peer claims ≠ what you verified — UI must show both.

m5.title: Capstone: approve a stranger
m5.concept: Walk announce → preview → approve → crawl without trusting vibe.

site.quickstart_intro: Clone the repo, install deps, and run labs against the live public hub (or COURSE_OFFLINE=1 fixtures).
site.exercises_body: Fill stubs in courselib/exercises.py, then python labs/run_exercises.py.
site.certificate_intro: Certificates are issued only by the CLI after every exercise stub passes — not by ticking boxes in the browser.
site.certificate_locked: Fill # YOUR CODE stubs in courselib/exercises.py, then run python labs/run_exercises.py --certificate "Your Name".
site.footer: Part of the AIMarket ecosystem — live federation APIs at modelmarket.dev.

exercises.heading: Exercise
exercises.lab01_hint: Assert fixture well-known has name, federated_capabilities_count, and hybrid signature (hybrid_signature_info).
exercises.lab02_hint: Call open_vs_closed on FIXTURE_PEERS; assert door=open and preview_independent_of_door.
exercises.lab03_hint: Call preview_quarantine(peers_payload=FIXTURE_PEERS); assert search/invoke never read preview.
exercises.lab04_hint: peer_summary on the pending stranger: declared=7, preview=3, gap=4.
exercises.lab05_hint: announce_checklist() steps must be announce → pending → preview → approve → crawl.

lab01_well_known_announce.hint: Read live /.well-known/ai-market.json — name, counts, hybrid sig.

lab02_open_vs_closed.hint: Compare open_federation with pending_count; preview is separate.

lab03_preview_quarantine.hint: Quarantine table is never searchable or invocable.

lab04_declared_vs_read.hint: Show declared vs observed counts side by side.

lab05_approve_capstone.hint: Checklist + live peer probe of modelmarket.dev.
